description.value: A vegetarian pizza and bakery operation tagged in OSM as a Chilliwack fast-food outlet, with a menu centred entirely on meatless specialty pizzas including paneer, roasted garlic, and Greek veggie varieties. The brand identity ('Think Vegetarian') makes it a natural stop for plant-based touring cyclists passing through the area. Gluten-free crust is available on request, and the operation appears to be takeout-focused.
